messages:
Dina (AE): Orchard HealthTech POC request — they need SOC 2 excerpt, ISO27001 excerpt about encryption/residency, a signed pen-test attestation, answers to a short security questionnaire, and a 1-hour authenticated scan window on staging. Also asked whether a 3-day dedicated-node trial would change POC pricing. Can we do next Tue 10:00 PDT?
Vik (Solutions Eng): I can bundle SOC2 + ISO snippets and draft the questionnaire answers. For an authenticated scan we'll create a scoped read-only DB user (no admin rights, no KMS access). Need to confirm acceptable auth method (basic vs token).
Rory (Security): Authenticated scan OK with constraints: scoped user with minimal privileges, no access to KMS/HSM, explicit list of endpoints excluded (admin/backup endpoints), and MFA off for that account for the window only. We also require scanner IPs, UA, and the test account name. We'll redact internal ticket links before sharing artifacts.
Dina (AE): Orchard secops contact: secops@orchardhealth.io. They said scanner will come from 54.241.77.88 and UA "OrchardScan/4.2". They prefer token-based auth for the test account. Window requested Tue 09:50 PDT -> 11:00 PDT (they want a 1h window but added buffer).
Leah (Infra): /32s OK. Provide exact CIDR(s) and token format so infra can allow and monitor. Also tell us expected rate and whether ASN needed to be whitelisted.
Vik (Solutions Eng): We'll issue an OAuth2 token with scope read:items and expiry 2h. Test account name: orchard-poc-scan. Expected rate: low (~30 r/s). No ASN needed, just the IPs and UA.
Rory (Security): We'll also require a signed pen-test attestation on their letterhead confirming authorized testing + indemnity. LegalBot will need signer_name, signer_title, company_name, company_tax_id, testing_scope, desired_return_email.
Dina (AE): Filling LegalBot fields now: signer_name: Maria Alvarez; signer_title: Head of Security; company_name: Orchard HealthTech LLC; company_tax_id: US-98-7654321; testing_scope: authenticated external vulnerability scan of staging endpoints only using provided token-scoped account; desired_return_email: secops@orchardhealth.io
LegalBot: Received fields. Also request whether Orchard requires any GDPR/PHI-specific language in the attestation (yes/no) and the billing contact for any dedicated-node trial. Return signed PDF within 48 hours after verification.
Dina (AE): Orchard replies: yes, include PHI handling clause; billing contact: procurement@orchardhealth.io.
Vik (Solutions Eng): Uploaded evidence bundle (SOC2 + ISO excerpt + questionnaire draft + token-creation steps) to presigned S3 (24h expiry): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/orchard/package.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400
Rory (Security): I'll review and mark redactions (no KMS contents, no prod hostnames). LegalBot, include PHI clause and our non-destructive testing paragraph in the attestation.
Leah (Infra): Firewall plan: open 54.241.77.88/32 at Tue 09:45 PDT, close at 11:05 PDT. Add auto-rollback if traffic exceeds 250 r/s. CIDR to apply:
```
54.241.77.88/32
```
Leah (Infra): Also request the token prefix so we can create monitoring rules tied to the test account.
Vik (Solutions Eng): Token prefix will be orchard-poc- (we'll DM the full token). We'll rotate token immediately after close and log all activity.
Rory (Security): Confirmed. Security will watch for anomalous API patterns and redact before sharing. Also remind Orchard we don't permit destructive testing.
Dina (AE): Pricing question from Orchard: is there a short 3-day dedicated-node trial quote? Vik, can you post a ballpark and I'll route to procurement?
Vik (Solutions Eng): Quick estimate: 3-day dedicated small GPU pool ~ $6k (non-binding). I'll escalate to pricing for formal quote if they want to proceed.
LegalBot: Drafting attestation with PHI and non-destructive clauses; will return signed PDF within 48 hours after security redaction confirmation and receipt of billing contact.
Dina (AE): Passing to Orchard: secops@orchardhealth.io and procurement@orchardhealth.io. I'll update once LegalBot returns signed attestation or if infra needs further details. :white_check_mark:
